## Privacy, safety, and cost

- [ ] Tests and examples use synthetic inputs only—no personal faces, voices, songs, keys, provider responses, or private projects.
- [ ] Logs, paths, identifiers, and screenshots are redacted.
- [ ] Tests make no external or paid calls and require no credentials or corporate tools.
- [ ] I documented provider data flow, retention/policy assumptions, and costs (unknown does not mean zero), if affected.
- [ ] I have rights and informed consent for every submitted likeness, voice, musical work, logo, and other asset.
- [ ] Identity QA is not described as perfect or as proof of consent/ownership.
